headline: FSB issues 12 nonbinding AI governance practices for financial institutions
summary: On October 15, the Financial Stability Board published a final report with 12 nonbinding practices for responsible AI adoption by financial institutions. The practices span board-level oversight and organization-wide risk governance, plus lifecycle controls for use-case assessment, model selection, data, transparency, performance, human oversight, cyber/ICT and third-party dependencies. The FSB says the report was revised after public consultation, including broader documentation and third-party-risk treatment and additional discussion of agentic and multi-agent systems. It calls the practices an adaptable toolkit rather than a binding standard; the report says agentic-specific guidance remains nascent.
